decisive_items: Serial CMV viral load measurements:  * 63 IU/mL (1 month after initial treatment)  * 1089 IU/mL  * 321 IU/mL  * 340 IU/mL  * 660 IU/mL  * 1660 IU/mL and 3171 IU/mL (during hospital admission)
Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes
response.rationale: High CMV viral load and mutations in UL97 and UL54 genes indicate CMV infection

rejected.why: Chronic bronchiectasis is a known condition but does not explain the current symptoms and high CMV viral load
PCP prophylaxis failure is possible but not supported by the CT scan results
MAC infection is a possibility but the current symptoms and high CMV viral load suggest a different diagnosis
IRIS is possible but the low CD4 count and undetectable HIV viral load are not sufficient to support this diagnosis
MAC pulmonary infection is a known condition but does not explain the current symptoms and high CMV viral load
